dataBoundary: P1-B.1 role paths are controlled trial directions, not employment judgments. They are used with rule hits, evidence links, and manual project records.

rolePaths.title: Industry AI product assistant
targetUserSignals: product requirement writing or user story experience
AI tool usage for drafting, search, or structured analysis

jdSignalReferences.normalizedLabel: MVP scope, user stories, QA pairs, acceptance criteria
citation display, failure cases, review boundary

riskBoundaries: Does not certify product manager readiness.
Does not convert public project capabilities into user-owned project experience.
Requires source, license, and boundary notes in exported material.
evidenceRequirements: At least one user-authorized background signal.
At least one sample JD trend reference.
At least one manually checked open-source project record.

rolePaths.title: Industry AI solution assistant
targetUserSignals: customer communication, consulting, sales support, or delivery coordination
scenario research and solution material drafting
PoC planning, demo script writing, or handoff checklist experience
ability to explain boundaries to business stakeholders

jdSignalReferences.normalizedLabel: PoC scope, demo script, handoff checklist
delivery boundary and professional review boundary

riskBoundaries: Does not promise customer delivery results, timelines, cost savings, or sales outcomes.
Does not replace domain expert, contract, or implementation review.
Requires clear separation between public reference capability and user trial output.
evidenceRequirements: At least one user-authorized communication or scenario signal.
At least one sample JD trend reference.
At least one manually checked open-source project record.

rolePaths.title: AI data evaluation assistant
targetUserSignals: annotation, QA, content review, testing, spreadsheet, or data-cleaning work
ability to define label criteria, quality checks, and error categories
basic metric interpretation without replacing professional model evaluation

jdSignalReferences.normalizedLabel: evaluation set, error analysis table, quality checklist
no model quality conclusion without expert review

riskBoundaries: P1-B.1 has no approved project record for a full data evaluation trial package.
Does not state model quality conclusions as professional evaluation.
Candidate project types must remain pending until license and README checks are complete.
evidenceRequirements: At least one user-authorized data or QA signal.
At least one sample JD trend reference.
A manually checked project record is required before full trial-package generation.

rolePaths.title: AI application operations and implementation assistant
targetUserSignals: operations, implementation, customer support, training, SOP, or knowledge-base maintenance
ability to write launch checklists, feedback loops, and support materials
experience translating user feedback into maintainable process changes

jdSignalReferences.normalizedLabel: training material, feedback workflow, support checklist
no production delivery or compliance substitute

riskBoundaries: P1-B.1 has no separate approved implementation project record for a full trial package.
Does not state enterprise production implementation delivery.
Does not replace security, compliance, operations, or domain review.
evidenceRequirements: At least one user-authorized operations or implementation signal.
At least one sample JD trend reference.
A manually checked project record is required before full trial-package generation.

excludedPaths.title: Algorithm and LLM engineer
excludedPaths.reason: P1-B.1 does not use this as a short-term main trial path for non-CS users unless the user supplies strong programming, machine-learning, model-training, and engineering evidence.
riskBoundaries: Do not turn OpenDocuments analysis into algorithm engineering experience.
Do not create a trial package for this path in DATA-004.
